Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the quick self-signup flow — we submitted a request yesterday and wanted to follow up directly. We operate a conversational embedding pipeline and are looking at Redwood Dedicated for predictable throughput.

High-level requirements:
- Peak QPS: ~480–520 requests/sec (short requests, avg tokens per request ~24)
- Latency target: p95 <= 120ms for generate endpoints, p99 under 220ms if possible
- Concurrent sessions: ~200 long-lived sessions during peak windows
- Region: prefer us-west (primary), fallback us-east for DR

Can we schedule a short (30–40m) technical demo to validate latency/run a quick load profile? We can make engineers available but procurement may need to be on call for contract questions.

Availability (PDT): Tue 6/24 9–11a, Tue 6/24 3–5p, Wed 6/25 10a–1p.

Thanks,
Samira
Samira Khan
Head of ML Engineering
EchoData Labs

1) Would you be able to share a 2–5 minute sample of typical request/response payloads (we saw one file attached — perfect).
2) Do you want the session to focus on latency SLOs or on throughput scaling and autoscale behavior? We can do both, but the agenda below is common: intro (5m), architecture & routing (10m), live throughput profile (15–20m), next steps (5m).
3) Who should be the contract/procurement contact (I’ll loop them once timing is locked)?

I have these windows open (PDT): Tue 6/24 9:30–10:30a, Tue 6/24 3:00–4:00p, Wed 6/25 11:00–11:45a. Laura (AE) is cc’d — she’ll join for commercial/next-step alignment. Ben (SDR) will help coordinate invites.

If any of these work, I’ll send a calendar invite and attach our Dedicated demo checklist so your engineering team can prepare payloads and test keys.

Cheers,
